import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Separate features and target
# Drop Id column since it is used for submission but not for modeling
train_X = train_df.drop(["Id", "Cover_Type"], axis=1)
train_y = train_df["Cover_Type"]

test_X = test_df.copy()
test_id = test_df["Id"].values

# Perform a strict hold-out split on training data to avoid leakage and meet requirements
# Split 80% train, 20% val to evaluate on unseen data
X_train_sub, X_val_sub, y_train_sub, y_val_sub = train_test_split(
    train_X, train_y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_y
)

# Initialize and train LightGBM model (simple base configuration)
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.05, max_depth=-1, num_leaves=31, random_state=42
)
model.fit(X_train_sub, y_train_sub)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val_sub)
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_sub, val_predictions)
print(
    f"Multi-class Classification Accuracy on Hold-out Validation Set: {validation_accuracy}"
)

# Prepare submission for external test data
test_predictions = model.predict(test_X)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_id, "Cover_Type": test_predictions})

# Ensure header matches template
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
